# Black Friday Countdown

> Live countdown to Black Friday with exact dates for every future year (through 2030), Cyber Monday dates, deal timing and FAQ. All dates are calculated in the visitor's browser — no data is collected.

## URL
- Home: https://blackfriday.toolara.dev/
- Embeddable countdown widget (iframe, free): https://blackfriday.toolara.dev/embed
- Privacy: https://blackfriday.toolara.dev/privacy

## Key facts
- Black Friday 2026: Friday, November 27, 2026 (the Friday after US Thanksgiving, the fourth Thursday of November)
- Cyber Monday 2026: Monday, November 30, 2026
- Future Black Friday dates: 2027-11-26, 2028-11-24, 2029-11-23, 2030-11-29
- The site auto-rolls to the next year after the Black Friday weekend ends; the countdown, answer box and date table stay in sync.

## Usage
Free to cite. The countdown widget may be embedded on any site via a one-line iframe (see /embed.html).
